changelog:
v2.13.6 - Touch freeze fixed

- Eye Care tint is explicitly not-touchable again and no longer advertises itself to the input system, which is what let Samsung One UI treat it as a tapjacking overlay and swallow every tap above the navigation bar.
- Filter strength is capped at 68%, so Android never classifies the tint as an obscuring window that blocks touches.
- The Eye Care notification now has a Turn off filter button, so you can never be trapped behind the tint.
- Split bubble: phone-wide split needs Shizuku; without it the app now says so plainly instead of half-working only inside Empire.
